budget_config._comment: W1.1 fixed per-spec budget escalation schedule (PLAN.md Stage 1). Escalation order is FIXED: baseline -> repair-r1 -> repair-r2 (iterative rounds, each fed the previous candidate's failure evidence) -> repair-bestofN (independent samples at higher temperature) -> repair-mutation (symbolic operator swaps on near-misses). 'defaults' applies to every spec; 'per_spec' entries override individual keys only, with a '_reason' string required for each (Rule 1 discipline: no silent budget games). Changing this file changes the reported inference budget -- every ledger row records the values in force (Rule 3).

28._reason: HPC-certified large state space (GATE0_STATUS.md); short TLC budgets only measure the timeout, not the repair
